facts_checked.identity: UF appendicular osteosarcoma vaccine added to amputation and standard chemotherapy
facts_checked.recruitment_sites: Currently recruiting at University of Florida, Gainesville; affected limb amputation and sampling at UF
facts_checked.eligibility: Recently diagnosed appendicular osteosarcoma, treatment naive, no other life-threatening disease; restricted medications and no concurrent OSA study
facts_checked.funding: Owner pays evaluation, amputation, chemotherapy, six vaccine doses, diagnostics and visits; injection-site reaction treatment covered up to $100 only
facts_checked.contacts: UF Oncology 352-392-2235; Study Interest and required Oncology Referral forms; VM-ClinicalStudies@ufl.edu

facts_checked.identity: UF tumor-derived RNA nanoparticle vaccine plus IV anti-PD-1 for appendicular osteosarcoma
facts_checked.recruitment_sites: Currently enrolling at University of Florida, Gainesville
facts_checked.eligibility: Microscopically confirmed limb OSA; UF pretreatment biopsy for vaccine production; radiation required; mild metastasis only at investigator discretion; medication and concurrent-study exclusions
facts_checked.funding: Owner pays standard diagnosis/treatment and radiation; study covers vaccine production, vaccine exams and safety/immune monitoring, with case-by-case imaging/radiation support and up to $1,000 for immediate anaphylaxis treatment
facts_checked.contacts: UF Oncology 352-392-2235; Study Interest and Oncology Referral forms; listed PIs Milner, Sayour and Ligon

facts_checked.identity: Purdue three-drug canine InvUC trial using cPD-L1 antibody, vinblastine and deracoxib in randomized sequence arms without placebo
facts_checked.recruitment_sites: Actively recruiting at Purdue University Veterinary Hospital
facts_checked.eligibility: Good general health, creatinine <=2.0 mg/dL, biopsy-confirmed or strongly suspected bladder/urethral InvUC confirmed during study; no prior chemotherapy/radiation; NSAID and supplement washouts
facts_checked.funding: Owner pays $300 per Purdue study visit; study covers remaining Purdue cancer-treatment/monitoring and study-side-effect costs; unrelated/referring-veterinarian care remains owner-paid
facts_checked.contacts: Clinical trials technician Lindsey Fourez, lfourez@purdue.edu, 765-494-1130; hospital scheduling 765-494-1107

facts_checked.identity: Zurich canine suspected meningioma genomic radiosensitivity study with biopsy/MRI and ten-session radiotherapy
facts_checked.recruitment_sites: Participation currently possible at Universitaeres Tierspital Zurich; page updated 26 October 2026
facts_checked.eligibility: Dogs with suspected meningioma; final anesthesia and radiotherapy suitability determined by Zurich
facts_checked.funding: Tumor biopsy and MRI are free; follow-up visits are discounted; other treatment costs are not stated as covered
facts_checked.contacts: Study participation contact form on the official Zurich protocol; hospital small-animal switchboard 044 635 81 12

facts_checked.identity: Zurich fluorescence-guided surgery study using ICG or investigational Angiostamp for canine/feline soft-tissue sarcoma
facts_checked.recruitment_sites: Participation currently possible at Universitaeres Tierspital Zurich; page updated 26 October 2026
facts_checked.eligibility: Confirmed STS requiring surgery, or incompletely excised STS requiring revision; severe heart/kidney disease that prevents anesthesia excludes, while mild controlled disease may be allowed
facts_checked.funding: Swiss National Science Foundation support covers the main part of surgery costs
facts_checked.contacts: Official oncology study contact form; Prof. Mirja Nolff research group; hospital small-animal switchboard 044 635 81 12

facts_checked.identity: Ohio State weakened LCMV intratumoral injection plus tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte expansion/reinfusion for canine oral melanoma
facts_checked.recruitment_sites: Current Ohio State individual protocol and registry record say actively recruiting at Columbus
facts_checked.eligibility: Otherwise healthy dogs with localized cytology/histology-confirmed oral melanoma accessible for injection/biopsy; immune deficiency/immunosuppressants and prior local radiation exclude
facts_checked.funding: Study covers biopsy, two CTs, trial bloodwork, virus/injections and immune-cell procedures; $800 post-trial incentive; other owner costs require confirmation
facts_checked.contacts: Blue Buffalo Veterinary Clinical Trials Office, CVM-ClinicalTrials@osu.edu, with official prescreen questionnaire
